facts.text: Deborah gave Jolene a mug with a handwritten message to encourage her.

evidence.quote: I'll give you a mug just like this one! It encourages.
Thanks, Deb! This really cheered me up.

facts.text: Jolene expressed gratitude for Deborah's encouragement and wished her well with her classes.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Deb! This really cheered me up. All the best with your classes. Bye!
Thanks, Jolene! Glad I could bring a smile to your face.

facts.text: Deborah encouraged Jolene to take time to relax and emphasized the importance of self-care.

evidence.quote: Take care and make sure to give yourself some time to relax.
